notes: Authoritative source: official Vivitek DU9800Z User's Manual (UM9801017EN00, downloaded via projectorcentral.com mirror of vivitekcorp.com PDF) plus vivitekcorp.com product spec page, cross-checked against vivitekusa.com and projectorcentral.com. This is a large-venue fixed-install laser projector (18,000 ANSI lumens, WUXGA), desktop/ceiling-mount form factor — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted/0. Sold body-only ("no lens"); five optional motorized lens types (0.84:1 to 7.0:1 throw ratio) are separate accessories not part of the fixed I/O. The "VGA (5 BNC)" component input and the SDI In/Out and 3D Sync In/Out are all BNC-style connectors sharing the same physical form factor; SDI is graded 3g per the spec sheet's explicit "3G-SDI" designation (confirmed via manual's remote-control legend "3G-SDI" and spec table "3G-SDI-In/Out"). Power inlet is confirmed as AC IEC-type inlet with a rocker power switch, rated 100-240V 50/60Hz, 1200W@110V/1800W@240V (spec table) vs 1950W±5% (vivitekcorp spec page) — manual does not explicitly print "C19" or "C13" on the connector, so the exact IEC sub-variant is inferred from the power class (up to 11.7A at 200-240V per product label shown in manual) rather than confirmed; flagged as the one area of residual uncertainty. HDMI grade is confirmed HDMI 1.4a per manual/spec table. DisplayPort version is not stated in any source (ProjectorCentral/manual just say "DisplayPort") so no grade was set. All other connectors (component BNC group, VGA, RS-232, 3D sync, trigger, wired remote) are not bandwidth-graded per the connector-grade rules and correctly omit "grade". Trigger jacks are 3.5mm mini-jack per the manual's own pinout diagram (Tip/Ring/Sleeve, VCC 12V) — mapped to trs-3.5 as the closest listed connector type since it is a control/trigger signal, not full TRS audio.

ports.name: VGA (V/H/B-Pb/G-Y/R-Pr, 5 BNC)
ports.note: 5x BNC group for RGBHV or YPbPr component; labeled V, H, B/Pb, G/Y, R/Pr on panel

ports.name: SDI In/Out
ports.note: Shared IN/OUT BNC pair labeled on panel as IN-SDI-OUT; spec sheet lists as 3G-SDI In/Out

ports.name: 3D Sync In/Out
ports.note: 3D IR sync transmitter connection, separate In and Out BNC jacks

ports.name: Trigger 1/2 (12V)
ports.note: x2 3.5mm mini-jack screen trigger outputs, 12V DC control signal

ports.name: Wired Remote
ports.note: 3.5mm mini-jack for wired remote control accessory, not a signal/AV port

ports.name: HDBaseT/LAN
ports.note: Single shared RJ45 for HDBaseT signal reception or network/control LAN

ports.name: AC Inlet
ports.note: AC 100/110-240V 50/60Hz; exact IEC inlet sub-type (C19/C13) not stated in manual, inferred C19-class given up to 1950W/11.7A draw
